fields.summary: Sync docs, demos, and Storybook after native Authoring parity

content.text: Follow-on to DAS-179: proof apps now use native Vue/Svelte Authoring, recording-interrupt UX, and rd-equirect-sphere-viewport / rd-flat-video-viewport. Builder palette already registers the new types; docs, About/demo copy, and Storybook catalog still describe the old Svelte ReactMount Authoring path and legacy rd-equirect-viewport WC pipeline.
Update DESTINATION_ATLAS_CROSS_FRAMEWORK_SHOWCASES and About-related copy: remove stale Svelte React Authoring row; reflect native Vue/Svelte Authoring and WC sphere/flat viewports.
Sync docs/43-destination-atlas-proof-apps.md, README.md, apps/client/public/readme.md, and article references that mention React Authoring on Svelte.

Storybook (optional but in scope): add palette demos and media-authoring meta composition entries for visual.media.equirect-sphere-viewport and visual.media.flat-video-viewport; refresh catalog spec/group guide text.
Consider @rosettadash/vue and @rosettadash/svelte package.json exports for sphere/flat viewport wrappers (npm consumers).
